stage: Candidate feature definitions; the model comparison identifies which features are used.

features.label: Reported exercise frequency
features.description: Share of observed exercise-report days with a Yes response to vigorous exercise. Self-report, not sensor-derived exercise minutes.

features.label: Change in reported sleep
features.unit: hours: second half minus first half
features.description: Mean sleep in days 15–28 minus days 1–14; at least three observed days in each half. Negative means less sleep later.

features.label: Day-to-day conversation variation
features.description: Sample SD of detected conversation minutes across event-days. Not a measure of total social interaction.

features.label: Change in detected conversation
features.unit: minutes: second half minus first half
features.description: Second-half minus first-half mean, with three recorded event-days per half. Negative means less detected conversation later; missing event-days are not zeros.

features.label: Day-to-day phone-lock variation
features.description: Sample SD of phone-locked duration across recorded event-days. Not variation in screen-use duration.

features.label: Change in phone-locked duration
features.unit: hours: second half minus first half
features.description: Second-half minus first-half mean of recorded phone-locked hours, requiring three event-days in each half.

features.label: Nighttime phone-locked duration
features.description: Mean recorded locked time between midnight and 06:00, requiring three nights with recorded lock events. This is not nighttime phone-use duration.

limitations: Exercise is an active self-report, not passive activity sensing.
Locked duration is not phone-use duration. Nighttime use remains unmeasured.
Conversation change is a change in detected events, not a confirmed drop in social interaction.
Event-day means and changes depend on recording coverage.
Seven reserved participants were excluded before raw feature processing.
No feature selection by outcome correlation, no model retraining, and no new holdout evaluation performed.
